name: Email Template System
description: Builds a personal email template set for the user's most common email types with variable placeholders and a quick-lookup guide. Use when the user sends similar emails repeatedly, wants to speed up email writing, or needs standardized responses for common situations. Do NOT use for writing a single specific email (use writing skills instead), cold outreach sequences (use `cold-email-outreach`), or enterprise email campaign templates (use business marketing skills instead).
